topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The flowers arrived this morning, a sudden bloom of color against the dull hum of the day. No card, no note, just a cluster of blooms wrapped in paper that seemed too fragile, as if the touch of a breeze might unravel it. I traced the petals, soft and yielding, wondering where they came from and why they were here. Each petal a question, each stem a silent whisper. The world outside continued to spin, oblivious, as if the sun and moon had conspired to keep secrets. I couldn’t shake the sense that the air around me was heavy, thick with unspoken words and unseen shadows.
